nina: quick sync postmortem followups — can we lock down a minimal handoff protocol so followups don't stall between teams? thoughts on roles / cadence / tiny template? :clipboard:

sam: +1. keep it minimal: triage owner, remediation owner, validator, and a followup-IC who rotates. recommend 48h triage, 10d remediation window, 30d validate.

kevin: propose a 4-field root template that shows up in the postmortem header so reviewers see status immediately. e.g.
```yaml
root_summary: "1-line blameless summary"
next_step: "deploy/rollback/monitor"
owner: "team/name"
due: "YYYY-MM-DD"
recurrence: "none|suspect|confirmed"
```
make recurrence and evidence mandatory if suspect/confirmed.

tara: handoff protocol idea: when triage complete, oncall IC creates a followup card on the shared board and assigns remediation owner. followup-IC checks the board every 3 days during their rotation and runs a 15-min unblock call if any card is blocked.

nina: comms cadence: 72h summary update in the postmortem + weekly digest for followups older than 7 days. also add a "remediation office hours" slot once a week for unblockers.

sam: rotation specifics: followup-IC = 2-week volunteer block. oncall IC only owns Phase 0 (triage). followup-IC owns Phase 1 (remediation) for their block and coordinates validators.

kevin: automation notes: board automation should: 1) auto-add due dates from ticket fields, 2) send reminders at 50% and 90% of SLA, 3) snooze low-confidence recurrence tags until human-verify.

ton: (ops-bot) created followup board template https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-5555 and scheduled a reminder in 72h. :gear:

nina: action items: kevin to add YAML snippet to the postmortem template (due 24h), tara to draft handoff checklist + board flow (due 72h), sam to publish rotation signup and calendar (due EOW). I'll write a one-pager "Followup Handoff Protocol" to pin to the board.

kevin: will update template and require evidence pointer when recurrence!=none.

tara: starting board flow now, will post automation rules for review.

sam: will post rotation signup in #people-ops and ping ops for calendar automate.

ton: reminder scheduled: followup owners check-in in 72h (thread 1766666666).

nina: thanks all — if no objections I'll attach the one-pager to RI-5555 and close this thread. reopen on any blocker. :sparkles:
